title: European grid, 4 November 2006: Landesbergen busbar coupling (UCTE incident)
source: UCTE Final Report, System Disturbance on 4 November 2006 (30 January 2007); reduced 380/220 kV network reconstructed by PlantAgent from public maps (not TSO data)
question: Dispatchers plan to couple the busbars at Landesbergen to relieve the Landesbergen-Wehrendorf line. Will it relieve the line, and is the grid N-1 secure afterwards?
data_note: Event data from the UCTE Final Report (2007). The 380/220 kV network around Landesbergen is a PlantAgent reconstruction from public maps with typical line parameters, not TSO data. The investigators' conclusion is withheld from the agent.
